title: Estey & Curtis Drug Store opened in this building in 1911. (Current Day & Ross)
description: This building was originally constructed in 1905 by John T. G. Carr as The Hartland Store, a general merchandise business. In August 1911, Samuel Miller, manager of Estey & Curtis, purchased the property, relocating his pharmacy into the spacious three-storey brick building and expanding into retail. The business was renamed Estey and Curtis Wholesale & Retail Druggist. At the time, Frank Aiton worked as a pharmacist. When Mr. Miller expanded his growing business to Fredericton, Mr. Aiton took over as manager of the Hartland Store and, in 1946, purchased it. The business was then renamed Aiton Drug Co. Ltd. Wholesale & Retail Druggists. Current headquarters of Day & Ross Transportation Group.
